scope: Project Context Persistence Phase D3 duplication risk audit
tracking_duplication_risk: A blind rerun could append duplicate rows to snapshot or tracking ledgers if the original side effects had already completed.
report_duplication_risk: A blind rerun could overwrite or duplicate report append sections without checking whether the previous run already wrote the target output.
state_transition_duplication_risk: A blind rerun could append duplicate checkpoint transition records or mark a future checkpoint complete twice.
control_policy: inspect validation artifacts before declaring success
inspect checkpoint state before appending transitions
